_readme: Curated manufacturer rows for builders the restored SkyDex dump does not carry (docs/aircraft-subject-content-plan.md). The dump's `manufacturers` collection is 66 rows and is almost entirely Western GA/airliner makers — the Eastern and a few niche builders are simply absent, so a curated type naming one of them was inserted with no builder pointer (no link on the type page, and the indexability gate then needs a photo or a catch). Applied insert-only by scripts/fix-aircraft-types.mjs BEFORE the type inserts, so new types resolve their pointer in the same run. Keys are the exact `manufacturer` string used in aircraft-types.json. `id` follows the dump's alphabetic scheme (AIR/BOE/EMB…) rather than its numeric one — a new row must not collide with the numeric ids that existing types point at. `country` is ISO2 into the shared country spine, and is reference data about the company, nothing to do with the flying-spots country table.
